mcq.q: A rollback restored the code but not the prompt and index. The missing practice is…
options: A release manifest that versions all behaviour-affecting artefacts
mcq.why: Behaviour depends on code, prompts, models, indexes and config together.
Shadowing a write creates real duplicate actions.

mcq.q: A candidate improves average accuracy but fails one cross-tenant case. Decision?
mcq.why: Critical invariants block regardless of average improvements.
